enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Body relaxed. Occasional turning. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Yawn. Remain still.
Open eyes. Sit up. Stretch arms overhead. Stretch legs. Yawn. Rub eyes. Turn body to side of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Reach for phone. Check time. Put phone down.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Take pan from cabinet. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Wash dishes.

Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Open door. Lock door. Walk to car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive to hospital. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Work as health care professional at hospital/clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient chart. Review patient notes. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Administer medication. Remove gloves. Wash hands. Write notes in chart. Walk to next patient.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Get in line. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Finish eating. Clear tray. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Work as health care professional at hospital/clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Continue patient rounds. Check on patients. Respond to call light. Assist patient with mobility. Administer IV. Monitor patient. Update records. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Answer phone. Write prescriptions. Coordinate with pharmacy. Educate patient. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Remove gloves.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver seat. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive home. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to front door. Unlock door. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take cutting board. Chop vegetables. Take pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relax, listen to music and monitor rolling blackout news on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Open music app. Play music. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open news app. Scroll through news. Read articles. Put down phone. Listen to music.

enriched_activities.activity: Complete continuing education modules on computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Navigate to module. Read module content. Answer quiz questions. Submit answers. Review feedback. Close browser. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Organize work bag and clothes for next day
enriched_activities.desc: Open closet. Select shirt. Select pants. Fold shirt. Fold pants. Place clothes on chair. Open work bag. Check contents. Add stethoscope. Add notebook. Add pen. Zip bag. Place bag by door.
Walk to living room. Pick up book from shelf. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Turn page. Close book. Place book on table.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Click on video. Watch video. Close app. Open messaging app. Send message. Lock phone. Place phone on nightstand.
Lie down in bed. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Remain still. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Yawn. Adjust blanket. Remain still.
